name: Dhananjay Vaidyanathan Rohini
headline: Social Impact Advisor | Partner at Alstonia Impact | INSEAD MBA | Global Health | Climate | Education
summary:
Specialties: Building data-driven strategies for philanthropists and impact investors, driving market making and innovative financing initiatives for intransigent societal problems, PMO for large-scale programs, providing interim management services for donors, impact investors, high-impact social organisations and governments

Sectors: Public Health, Education, Land and Property Rights, Skills and Employment, Climate Change and Sustainability, Urban Development

Background: Entrepreneurial leader with interdisciplinary background that combines strategy consulting, public policy, law, finance and new technology. Global outlook having lived in India, Germany, Mexico, Singapore and Japan. Fluent in English, German, Hindi, Tamil and Spanish

positions.title: Partner
positions.description: Alstonia Impact provides strategic and investment advisory services to philanthropists, multi-laterals, impact funds and non-profits in the area of public health, education and climate. We serve leading organizations such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, World Bank, Omidyar Network, One Acre Fund, UNICEF and Wadhwani AI.

positions.title: Consultant - Project Manager
positions.description:
Guided by the belief that every life has equal value, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation works to help all people lead healthy, productive lives. In developing countries, it focuses on improving people’s health and giving them the chance to lift themselves out of hunger and extreme poverty.

My role includes:
** Active management of the Foundation's portfolio in Uttar Pradesh (UP), India. Change in UP, with its large population of 200 million and dramatically poor social indicators, is imperative for the achievement of global UN Millennium Development Goals.
** Evaluation of potential investment opportunities in the state in the area of Health, Agriculture and Financial Services for the Poor
** Co-formulating the Foundation's strategy in the state along with the Deputy Director
** Liaising with and internal fundraising from thematic (HIV, Maternal and Child Health, etc.) teams in the HQ in Seattle for investments in India
